output.question: I have intervals planned today. Should I still do them?
output.reply_text:
I strongly recommend swapping today's intervals for an easy recovery session or taking a full rest day. Your recent data shows clear signs of acute systemic fatigue, with sleep averaging just 5 hours and 18 minutes alongside suppressed HRV (38 ms) and a readiness flag. Forcing high-intensity work in this state increases injury risk and blunts the training adaptation you are looking for [4]. 

If you still want to get moving, keep it strictly to an easy 30-minute Zone 1 jog or walk. Use the warm-up rule: if your legs feel heavy or you don't find a smooth, natural rhythm within the first 10 minutes, pull the plug immediately and focus on sleep and fueling so we can hit quality intervals later in the week [1, 4].
